text:
The question "When will Pest 6 be released?" requires distinguishing between two distinct software applications that use "Pest" or "PEST" in their name. For one, version 6 has already been released; for the other, there are currently no announced plans for a version 6.

## PEST Environmental Modeling Software: Version 6 Released in 2003

The environmental modeling software, known as PEST (Parameter ESTimation), is a comprehensive suite of programs designed for decision-support environmental modeling. It automates calibration and uncertainty analysis by interacting with a model's input and output files [1]. PEST version **6.05** was officially released in **April 2003**. This release was a General Release, built using FORTRAN, and ran on DOS operating systems [2]. Therefore, for this specific application, "Pest 6" is a historical release, having occurred over two decades ago.

## Pest PHP Testing Framework: Currently on Version 5, No Version 6 Announced

In contrast, Pest is also known as an elegant and comprehensive testing framework for PHP developers and AI agents [3]. This framework has undergone several major iterations. Pest v3 introduced significant features such as mutation testing, architectural presets, and a new configuration API [4]. Following this, Pest v4 was released in 2025, bringing browser testing capabilities and further enhancements to mutation testing [5].

The current major version of the PHP testing framework is **Pest 5**. This version is built on PHP 8.4 and PHPUnit 13, requiring PHP 8.4 or higher for operation [6]. Pest 5 was initially scheduled for release on July 28, 2026 [6]. As of October 1, 2026, the latest available release is **v5.3.0**, reflecting ongoing development within the version 5 series [7]. There is currently **no information available or announced release date** for a future "Pest 6" for this PHP testing framework in the provided sources [6][3][5][4].

## Conclusion: Differentiating "Pest 6" Release Status

The release status of "Pest 6" depends entirely on the specific software being referenced. Version **6.05** of the PEST environmental modeling software was released in **April 2003** [2]. For the popular Pest PHP testing framework, version 5 is the current major release, with its latest update being v5.3.0 as of October 1, 2026. However, there are **no announced plans or release dates** for a version 6 of the Pest PHP testing framework [7][6].

sources.title: Home | PEST
claims: PEST refers to a software package and a number of suites of utility programs that support it.
PEST is a software package that automates highly-parameterized calibration and calibration-constrained uncertainty analysis of any numerical model.
PEST interacts with a model through the model’s own input and output files.

PEST-support software suites perform tasks that assist and complement model parameter estimation and uncertainty analysis, including setup facilitation, flexible spatial parameterization, stochastic parameter field generation, multi-component objective function definition, linear and nonlinear prior and posterior uncertainty analysis, and data space inversion.

claims: Pest is an elegant testing framework for PHP developers and AI agents.
Pest brings the joy of testing to PHP.
Browser testing and AI evals are built into Pest.
Pest has a source code repository on GitHub.
Pest supports Test Impact Analysis (TIA) to run only affected tests.

Pest allows running browser tests using Playwright.
Pest can be used to evaluate LLM features like code.
Pest has over 70 million downloads.

sources.title: Pest v3 Now Available | Pest - The elegant PHP Testing Framework
claims: Pest 3 introduces Mutation Testing, Arch Presets, Team Management, a new Configuration API, and improvements to Architectural Testing.
Mutation Testing in Pest 3 introduces a new technique that introduces small changes to code to see if tests catch them.
Arch Presets in Pest 3 offer predefined rules for testing application architecture, including 'php', 'security', 'laravel', 'strict', and 'relaxed' presets.
Team Management in Pest 3 allows managing tasks and todos with a team directly from the console.
Pest 3 introduces a new configuration API based on the `pest()` function, intended to be more intuitive than the previous `uses()` function.
Pest 3 includes new architectural expectations such as `toUseStrictEquality()`, `toHaveMethodsDocumented()`, and `toHaveFileSystemPermissions()`.
Pest 3 introduces a new `after()` method for running teardown callbacks after specific tests or groups of tests.
Pest 3 is based on PHPUnit 11, allowing the use of any PHPUnit 11 features within Pest.
Pest 3 includes improvements such as Type Coverage checking for constants, better error messages, and basic support for static analysis tools within test closures.

sources.title: Medium
claims: Pest v4, a major release in 2025, added browser testing, improved mutation testing, a profanity filter, conditional skips, and enhancements to arch presets.
Pest runs on PHPUnit 12.
Pest is extremely popular in the Laravel ecosystem, with new projects defaulting to Pest since approximately 2023/2024.
PHPUnit 12, requiring PHP 8.3+, is the latest stable version, while PHPUnit 11 receives bug fixes until early 2026.

sources.title: Pest 5 Now Available | Pest - The elegant PHP Testing Framework
claims: Pest 5 is available and built on top of PHP 8.4 and PHPUnit 13.
Pest 5 requires PHP 8.4 or greater.
The Tia Engine in Pest 5 reduces test suite run time by re-running only affected tests.
The Agent Plugin in Pest 5 allows AI coding agents to verify code changes with a single command.
The Evals plugin in Pest 5 allows evaluation of LLM agents and AI-generated output.
Pest 5 includes a first-party PHPStan plugin to teach PHPStan about Pest's functional API.
Pest 5 includes an automated refactoring plugin powered by Rector.
Pest 5 refines test sharding with time-balanced sharding.
Pest 5 introduces new expectations: toBeEmail(), toBeUlid(), toBeIpAddress(), toBeMacAddress(), toBeHostname(), toBeDomain(), toBeBase64(), and toBeHexadecimal().
